research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Hinge Health is developing computer vision based assessment of posture of living bodies and approaches to posture programs, and patient centered musculoskeletal care systems and associated programs for exercise therapy. It also works on approaches to providing exercise therapy and systems for implementing the same, along with neuromodulation devices and methods for use, waveform generators and electrode interfaces that deliver variable and sequential waveforms for pain and related condition management. Together these focus on digital musculoskeletal care, exercise guidance, and neuromodulation.

overview_description.description: Hinge Health provides digital musculoskeletal care through virtual physical therapy, integrating clinical support with wearable technology and AI tools. Its platform offers personalized exercise programs, remote access to physical therapists, and devices like Enso, an FDA-cleared wearable for pain relief. The company serves employers and health plans aiming to reduce healthcare costs and improve employee well-being. Hinge Health's services address various conditions, including chronic pain and post-surgical recovery, and extend to international markets.
